Semantics of RP Service Function The RP Service Function is responsible for sampling (reading) and stimulating (writing) the bypass data. The action of sampling may then trigger the RP system to perform the bypass (this may involve the communication of the sampled data to an external system for computation) ready for reading when the stimulation occurs.
